title: JFK wanted to declassify UFO files before his death

tellings.quote: John Kennedy declared he wanted to declassify some secret files concerning aliens and UFOs.

plain: John F. Kennedy is said to have declared, in the years before his death, that he wanted to declassify secret files about aliens and UFOs. The claim comes from Kiran Ilum Xenov, a former president of one of Russia's republics, who says he was taken by aliens himself in 1997 and tells Michels that "John Kennedy declared he wanted to declassify some secret files concerning aliens and UFOs." If true, it would mean a sitting president meant to open records the government was keeping secret.
